decision: Selected the site location that the Environment Agency's installations register publishes for permit EPR/FP3630EU (holder Green Mountain DC UK Limited, 'Romford North Data Centre, Unit 3 King George Close, Romford, Essex, RM7 7PN'): latitude 51.587017, longitude 0.167675 (grid reference TQ5027089800), copied without transformation, as the campus locator of Green Mountain's LON-East campus. It is the regulator's site point for the permitted combustion installation serving the existing data-centre building, not a building outline or surveyed position.

selected_properties.address: ISDC Development (No2 Limited, Romford North Data Centre, Unit 3 King George close, Romford, Essex, RM7 7PN

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published latitude and longitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:27700 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's easting and northing gives 51.5870225, 0.1676681, 0.77 m from the published point.

consistency_checks.planning_polygon: The London Planning Datahub record of Havering permission P1238.23 (approved 6 October 2023, 'Erection of external fin wall to the front of the existing data storage facility', 3 King George Close, RM7 7PN; local gla/gla-Havering-P1238.23.json, sha256 a0e05989...) carries a 3.47 ha site polygon (7 vertices) and centroid 51.5871651, 0.1678894. With shapely 2.1.1 the register point lies inside that polygon, about 62 m inside its boundary and 22 m from its centroid, so the register point falls on the existing data storage facility's planning site.
consistency_checks.postcode_centroid: The ONS centroid of RM7 7PN (postcodes.io: E 550220, N 189726; 51.586373, 0.166942) lies 88 m south-west of the register point, so the register point is not a copy of the postcode point; the centroid itself is not used.
consistency_checks.adjacent_plot: Havering's data-storage permissions for the neighbouring plot at 5 King George Close (former Hubbinet Industrial Estate: P1137.11 of 23 January 2012, varied by P0614.20 of 14 January 2021, with a further section 73 variation P1029.26 validated 28 August 2026) have a 1.55-1.60 ha polygon whose centroid (51.585996, 0.1693495) is 162 m south-east of the register point; the point is 122-123 m outside that polygon, i.e. it marks the existing building, not the planned new building.
consistency_checks.imagery: Esri World Imagery z17 tiles (x 65596-65598, y 43537-43539; sha256 of the sorted per-tile shasum lines cea7f2ee6d59a957c018a476e72e04dda6ddbcbb746599c4f80bb6e59fcb12bb) viewed locally and not redistributed: the point falls on the roof of a large pale-roofed industrial building with rooftop plant and a plant yard along its southern side, with housing to the north and east and an open playing field to the south-west, consistent with the 11,000 m2 existing data-centre building Green Mountain describes. The imagery date is unknown and is not used as status evidence.
consistency_checks.other_sites: The nearest Atlas sites are the Charlton data centre proposal (14.2 km) and the Telehouse London Docklands campus (14.4 km); no Atlas record, queued addition or claim other than this one lies within 2 km.

uncertainty: The register publishes no positional accuracy; the point lies inside the 3.47 ha existing-facility planning polygon, and the campus extends over about 8 acres (3.2 ha) around and south-east of it.
